system.description:
Touch; you and up to 1 willing creature per three levels (max 6 others). Each projects a silvery astral body (your HP, copies of carried gear) that flies 150ft per round on the Astral plane and can enter other planes through portals; physical bodies lie Unconscious, needing no food, air or sleep and not ageing. Lasts 1 day per level or until you end it; the astral bodies then rejoin their bodies. If an astral body drops to 0 HP or below, that creature dies. No save. Material: a jacinth worth 1,000 gp, consumed, plus a silver bar worth 5 gp per additional traveller.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Cleric, Druid, Necromancer, Witch
